expected_answer: Undergraduates normally get four Q-drops at Texas A&M. State law also caps dropped courses at six across all Texas public schools. Q-drops in one-hour courses don't count toward the four but do count toward the six.

question: when's the last day to q drop a class in the fall
expected_answer: Through the 60th class day of a fall or spring semester (15th class day of a summer term, 35th of a 10-week summer semester); for Fall 2026 that was 5 p.m. Nov. 16. In the first twelve class days of fall or spring you can drop with no record at all. Giving the rule or the date is correct.

question: whats the max number of hours i can take in a semester
expected_answer: 19 hours in a fall or spring semester, and 14 hours across all sessions of a summer semester.

question: do i have to tell my prof before i miss class for it to be excused
expected_answer: Yes. You must notify the instructor in writing (email is fine) before the day of the absence. If that isn't possible, notify them by the end of the second business day after the absence and explain why you couldn't give notice.

question: how long do i have to turn in a doctors note after being sick
expected_answer: Within three business days of the last date of the absence.

question: i have 3 finals on the same day can i move one
expected_answer: Yes. You can request to reschedule one of them, but you must start the request no later than ten workdays before the first day of finals.

question: what gpa do you need for summa cum laude
expected_answer: 3.90 or above. Magna Cum Laude is 3.70 through 3.899 and Cum Laude is 3.50 through 3.699.

question: how many hours to be a junior
expected_answer: 60 semester hours passed (30 for sophomore, 90 for senior).

question: what gpa gets you on academic probation
expected_answer: You're scholastically deficient if your semester, cumulative, or major GPA is below 2.00. After review by your dean you may then be warned, allowed to continue on scholastic probation, or dismissed from your college or major.

question: what happens if i never pay my parking ticket
expected_answer: After 60 days the citation goes to a collection agency with extra collection fees, and a balance older than 120 days gets a State of Texas hold. Three or more unpaid citations, fines over $160, or any balance older than 90 days can also get your vehicle booted or towed.

question: how long do i have to appeal a parking ticket
expected_answer: 14 calendar days from the date the citation was issued, with valid documentation. Late, vague or incomplete appeals are rejected.

question: do i have to register my electric scooter
expected_answer: Yes. All micromobility on campus must be registered and display a permit. It costs $10 per device, and you register through Bike Index.

question: how much does it cost to ride the campus bus
expected_answer: Nothing: AggieSpirit buses don't collect fares. Have a Texas A&M, Blinn or Brazos Transit District ID ready to show the driver at off-campus stops.

question: are there ev chargers on campus
expected_answer: Yes. There are 8 DC Fast charging locations (up to 120 kW) and 31 Level 2 chargers on main campus, plus 8 Level 2 chargers at RELLIS.

question: i have a disability hangtag, do i still need to buy a parking permit
expected_answer: Yes. The county-issued disabled hangtag or plate works together with a Texas A&M parking permit or a paid visitor parking fee; with both, you can park in any available unrestricted space.

question: can i ride my bike to kyle field on gameday
expected_answer: Yes, but No Wheels Zones are in effect from 3.5 hours before the game to 1 hour after. Cyclists, skateboarders and scooter riders must dismount and walk through them.
